notes: An invite for a new person; it works once, for 24 hours. The token and link are shown only in this answer: the server keeps a hash. The link is for the QR code and for sending. POST /api/users/{id}/invites (no body) makes one that adds a phone for someone with an account, with their name and role. folders are the folders a new member will see, possibly none; an admin sees every folder, so they don't count for one. Errors: bad_request (400) for a missing name or an unknown role, not_found (404) for an unknown person or folder.
